physics-killer-12.title: Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa (Inquiry) (2)
physics-killer-12.topic: Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa (Inquiry) (2)
physics-killer-12.goal: Analyze the principles of Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa (Inquiry) (2) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-12.material: A kan fili a kwance an sanya layukan ƙarfe masu jagorantar wuta guda biyu masu daidaito, tazararsu $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, kuma an haɗa ƙarshe ɗaya da resistor. Jimillar juriyar da'irar da ta ƙunshi layukan, sandar ƙarfe mai jagorantar wuta, da resistor $2\,\Omega$ ne. Filin maganaɗisu mai daidaito a tsaye $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ yana rufe dukan da'irar, kuma sandar tana motsi a kan layukan da gudu tsayayye $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ a hanyar da ke nesanta daga resistor. A tsawon $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ da sandar ta yi motsi $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux da ke ratsa da'irar yana canzawa da $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, ƙarfin wutar da aka jawo da ke gudana a da'irar, da girman ƙarfin waje da ake buƙata don kiyaye sandar a gudu tsayayye? (Babu gogayya.)
physics-killer-12.thinking.0: Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa (Inquiry) (2)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: A kan fili a kwance an sanya layukan ƙarfe masu jagorantar wuta guda biyu masu daidaito, tazararsu $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, kuma an haɗa ƙarshe ɗaya da resistor. Jimillar juriyar da'irar da ta ƙunshi layukan, sandar ƙarfe mai jagorantar wuta, da resistor $2\,\Omega$ ne. Filin maganaɗisu mai daidaito a tsaye $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ yana rufe dukan da'irar, kuma sandar tana motsi a kan layukan da gudu tsayayye $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ a hanyar da ke nesanta daga resistor. A tsawon $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ da sandar ta yi motsi $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux da ke ratsa da'irar yana canzawa da $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, ƙarfin wutar da aka jawo da ke gudana a da'irar, da girman ƙarfin waje da ake buƙata don kiyaye sandar a gudu tsayayye? (Babu gogayya.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.explain: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ ($=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$, sun yi daidai). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Ƙarfin maganaɗisu da sandar ke samu $F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (a hanyar da take hana motsi bisa dokar Lenz) kuma tun da gudu tsayayye ne, ƙarfin waje ma $0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ ne. Tabbatarwa: ƙarfin aikin waje $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Idan aka manta da $\ell$ sai $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (amsa mara kyau ①); idan aka manta da $\ell$ a lissafin ƙarfi sai $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (amsa mara kyau ②); kuskuren ninka $\mathcal E$ da $\frac12$ shi ne amsa mara kyau ④.
